accessibilityReview.evidence: Largest feed and product screenshots/continuations show complete action labels/prices and full body text; primary/small actual UI and optimized Release passed. Normal teaser deliberately limited to2 lines per design, largest teaser expands. Contrast report targets next-card2/35 beneath native tab glass. No issue handler suppression.
accessibilityReview.requiredFollowup: Manual VoiceOver/contrast acceptance and further automated audit review before public launch.

accessibilityTrack: Unsuppressed fresh Shop audit retained separately. Automated findings do not become functional passes. No blanket accessibility sign-off.
initialCorrections: Functional tests caught feed reset on native Back; initialization now runs once and preserves category/card. Length regex initially lacked regular-expression matching; exact-option regression caught and fixed it. Final inspection caught default bottom alignment on tall feed cards; top anchor and full-height product names now verified, with flexible photo sizing. Single-choice products no longer claim other finish photos exist. Fresh-install QA caught a malformed bundled catalogue date; numeric Codable date encoding restored and a cold-install regression now verifies all9 sets and published Freak record. Larger-text Terry story requires more than16 scrolling gestures; the bounded harness now allows48 and verifies the real end action. Prior failed runs retained.

serviceSimulation.isolation: Synthetic loopback customers/database/Shopify events; browser blocks external writes; no production mutations

acceptedPlatformStandard: Native fitted PopSheet inset accepted in Review36. Prior approved non-Shop surfaces preserved.

carryOverEvidence.browser36: Previously passed; no public web/share/cart-handler changes. Scoped production deployment preserves hashes of those modules.

liveAcceptanceRemaining: Real Shopify OAuth/MFA, payment/tax/shipping/stock and email/wallet acceptance.
Physical Safari universal links, APNs, manual VoiceOver and older supported OS acceptance.
Merchant exact Silver/missing photographs and actual chain Length variants.
proofBoundary: Synthetic Claire captures, no real customer or checkout mutation. Review content renders do not replace shipping AppRoot and optimized Release checks. Public Hot rank examples synthetic; service live read-only ranking tested separately.
